utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the drive. Oren can bring something too.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just checking, it’s still at 6:00 today, right? I’ll keep an eye out.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, still 6:00. I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good, but we need to make sure the ladder and drill are actually at the site when we start, or we'll lose time.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll bring my tools and make sure the ladder and drill are on site before we start.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Right, and please keep Gus and Rey in the loop too so we’re not waiting on missing hands when it starts.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the repair drive list ready, and we’ll keep moving one house at a time. Opal’s tracking the location, and Bo can head to the first house now.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m helping with the repair drive too. Send me to the next house when Bo’s done there.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Mara. Stay close to the list, and once Bo finishes there, I’ll send you straight to the next house.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I brought the toolkit and the replacement screws. Where do you want me to start?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I brought my wrench set and a few odds and ends, so I can start wherever you need me.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’ll start with the fastening points along the frame. If you want, I can hand you screws while you tighten.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, Jules has been great about getting the word out and even brought by a few tools and supplies.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll keep repeating the plan to Eli and help keep the repair drive on track.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That should help a lot. If Eli hears it from both of us, the repair drive will stay on track.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Kira said she’d keep an eye out for the repair drive, and Gus has a couple spare wrenches and a drill if we need them.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That should cover it for now. I’ll let Ira know what’s still needed when they stop by.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive is underway now, and they’re sorting out the repairs as they go. Do you know if there’s anything still waiting on parts?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Vik said he’d repeat the plan, so I’m just waiting on that and keeping things steady.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it, I’m just waiting to hear what Vik says about the plan before anything else moves.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Rosa’s got the repair drive list ready, so we’re set.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got a drill and a ladder you can borrow if we need them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, then we’re covered.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m just checking what’s left on the repair drive before anyone starts. Mina has the toolkit and screws, and Leo can handle the wiring and loose mount work.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can take the next round, and I’m happy to help wherever you still need hands.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane. Once I confirm what’s left on the drive, I’ll tell you where to start.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what we still need and keep an eye on the supplies for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, thanks. I’ll keep track of it, and I’ll be there at six too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Opal. That helps a lot.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help after pickup, and Mara will be there then too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Good, then we’ve got enough hands on it after pickup. I’ll keep tracking the repair drive in case anything gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks. I’ll check in after pickup too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Come by at six at my place if you can—Opal’s on the list, and Dane may swing through late to help out too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yep, six works for me. I’ll be there then.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, see you at six.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on what the repair drive still needs and track the supplies with Noah.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Good to know, Cleo. I heard Kira’s keeping an eye out, and Gus has those spare wrenches and a drill if we need them.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good. I’ll keep tracking what’s left and stay in sync with Noah on supplies.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Right, Jules has been helping spread the word and even brought a few tools and supplies.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, six works for me. I’ll keep track of the location and see you there.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, then we’re set for six. I’ll see you there, and I’m glad Jules got the word out and brought those supplies.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’ve got the toolkit and the replacement screws. Where do you want me to start?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Start at the front entrance and work inward; I’ve got a ladder if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’ll start at the front entrance and work inward. If I hit anything tricky, I’ll use the ladder.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the heavier repairs, and Pia seems to have the schedule under control.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring over my drill and ladder for the heavier fixes.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, then we’ve got the heavy stuff covered. I’ll keep an eye on the repair drive schedule with Pia.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Come by at six at my place, and bring a hand if you can. Opal's on the list, and Dane may swing by later too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll stop by, though I may be a little late.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: No rush, just get here when you can. We’ll be working on it at six, and Opal’s set to be there too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help after pickup. Mara will be there then too, so we can coordinate it together.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good. If Vik repeats the plan, I’ll know we’re set for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Right, then we’re all set on my side after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, I’ll bring my wrench set and a few odds and ends.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yep, the repair drive is still on for 6:00, and I can be there then.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, see you at 6:00 with my wrench set and a few odds and ends.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m checking what’s still left on the repair drive before we do anything else.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’d check the heavy stuff and the tool list first, so we don’t get stuck halfway through.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check the heavy parts first, then confirm the tool list so we know exactly what’s left.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m in for the repair drive too, just running a little late as usual. Point me where you need an extra set of hands.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, Rosa’s got the list ready. Grab her when you get here and we’ll put you to work.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Will do. I’ll grab Rosa when I get there and get my hands on whatever needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, the repair drive's moving along. I’m keeping an eye on it in case anything gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Noah. I brought a few tools and supplies too, so if anything’s missing I can help fill the gap.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Appreciate it, Jules. If anything else is missing, just point me at it and I’ll keep track.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m helping with it too, and Dane has the hauling and cleanup covered.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the drive too. Oren said he wants to bring something, so I’ll check with him.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks — I’ll check with Oren and keep the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, 6:00 today still, and Sam can be there too? I'll keep an eye out.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, 6:00 still works, and Sam can come too. I’ve got the repair drive list ready, and we’ll keep moving one house at a time.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Good, 6:00 still works and Sam can come too. I’ll keep an eye out.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
